purpose: Freeze the exact pre-outcome family-wise inference and terminal decision rule for the already-frozen H1 Benchmark v0.1 directional R1 family. No market-data body, return, alpha, PnL, source acquisition, parameter search or implementation execution is permitted.

family_wise_freeze.substitution_rule: If the worker finds a concrete validity defect that makes Holm over the proposed marginal tests invalid or uninterpretable, do not substitute a more adaptive procedure. Return H1_R1_MULTIPLICITY_FREEZE_STRATEGY_ATTENTION_REQUIRED.

design_requirements: Verify the four-member R1 family, formulas, horizons and role eligibility exactly against the benchmark design and variant ledger; do not add or remove a member.
Freeze one exact threshold-free primary effect statistic suitable for continuous oriented features and fixed-horizon forward response. It must not require outcome-chosen cutoffs or winner ranking.

Freeze the exact primary inference/block unit and a dependence-valid marginal p-value construction. Event/minute rows may not be treated as IID. Cross-asset/common-day dependence must be addressed explicitly.

Use Holm-Bonferroni family-wise control at alpha=0.05 across exactly the four preoriented hypotheses. Do not replace Holm with max-stat/stepdown/bootstrap multiplicity unless this task returns Strategy Attention instead of silently changing the manager instruction.
Freeze exact null/alternative semantics for each family member after applying the stated orientation. No two-sided post-hoc reinterpretation and no sign rescue.
Freeze exact missing-block / insufficient-breadth / degenerate-statistic handling before outcomes.

Freeze family-level terminal semantics that distinguish: no discovery support, one-or-more multiplicity-controlled discovery-support members, inference/data invalid or insufficient, and stale-context review. A positive family result is Discovery support only, never Confirmation or promotion.
Require full disclosure of all four member results and adjusted decisions; no best-feature leaderboard or winner-only reporting.
State explicitly that R2/R3/R4/R6-only variants are outside this directional family and receive no standalone directional claim.
State explicitly that any later positive member remains ADAPTIVE_DISCOVERY_GENERATED and requires independent asset/time Confirmation before promotional interpretation.

acceptable_examples_for_consideration_on: calendar-block aggregated rank association with a predeclared dependence-valid resampling/test
calendar-block aggregated oriented signed response with a predeclared dependence-valid resampling/test
preferred_statistical_posture.forbidden_interpretation: Examples are not permission to inspect outcomes or try multiple statistics and keep the best. Select and freeze exactly one statistic/marginal test from theory and governance only.

terminal_rule: Persist exact_result_path first, verify it, refresh/revalidate current main and the exact task, then create/update worker_result_manifest_path LAST as the final repository artifact. After the manifest, write exactly one terminal PR receipt with CONTINUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true and STRATEGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true, then stop.
